_readme: One entry per figure[data-slot]. A step with several figures swaps the backdrop as you scroll through it, in HTML order. type: image | video (self-hosted; a silent clip needs no captions, one with speech needs a .vtt in captions). pos is the CSS object-position focal point for crops. credit {title, author, source, licence, url} in TASL form builds the Sources list. Photos are 1280px Wikimedia Commons thumbnails; check the licence on the file page before swapping one.

1919.alt: Black-and-white photo: a rider leads the sprint on the Parc des Princes track, another close behind, as a crowd in caps and hats leans over the fence
1919.caption: The finish at the Parc des Princes, Paris, 27 July 1919. Jean Alavoine leads Luigi Lucotti and Honoré Barthélémy.

credit.title: Parc des Princes, 27-7-19, arrivée du Tour de France
credit.author: Agence Rol

1919b.alt: Black-and-white photo: Firmin Lambot, mud-spattered and carrying a laurel wreath on his shoulder, rides a lap of honour past a packed grandstand
1919b.caption: Firmin Lambot's lap of honour at the Parc des Princes, 27 July 1919.

credit.title: Parc des Princes, 27-7-19, tour d'honneur de (Firmin) Lambot vainqueur du Tour de France
credit.author: Agence Rol

intro.alt: A small breakaway climbs a mountain road between motorbikes, with fans in polka-dot shirts lining the grass banks on both sides
intro.caption: The breakaway on the Peyresourde, stage 14, 2025.

credit.title: Breakway with crowd in Peyresourde during stage 14 of Tour de France 2025
credit.author: Hugo LUC

introb.alt: Riders lean through a cobbled bend in Montmartre while fans in polka-dot shirts and hats press against the barriers, filming on their phones
introb.caption: Stage 21 climbs through Montmartre, Paris, 26 July 2026.

credit.title: Étape 21 Tour France 2026 Rue Saint Éleuthère - Paris XVIII (FR75) - 2026-07-26 - 186
credit.author: Chabe01

1926.alt: Black-and-white photo: a rider in goggles and a spare tyre slung over his shoulders climbs a dirt mountain road, followed by a car
1926.caption: Lucien Buysse on the Col d'Aubisque, Bayonne to Luchon, 1926.

credit.title: Tour de France cycliste - étape Bayonne-Luchon - Lucien Buysse dans le col de l'Aubisque
credit.author: Agence Meurisse

1926b.alt: Black-and-white photo: a line of riders in goggles rounds a bend on a dirt road while villagers in caps watch from the verge
1926b.caption: Staudaerts, Buysse and Cuvelier over the Col de Port, Luchon to Perpignan, 1926.

credit.title: Tour de France cycliste - étape Luchon-Perpignan - passage dans le col de Port, Staudaerts, Buysse et Cuvelier
credit.author: Agence Meurisse

1926c.alt: Black-and-white photo: riders with spare tyres on their backs stretch out along a straight, dusty road through flat fields, an open car among them and a gendarme watching
1926c.caption: At the Pont de Lunel, Perpignan to Toulon, 1926.

credit.title: Tour de France cycliste - étape Perpignan-Toulon - passage au Pont de Lunel
credit.author: Agence Meurisse

1962.alt: Bare, high mountain slopes and a winding road falling into a green valley under a wide blue sky
1962.caption: The view from the Cime de la Bonette, Mercantour National Park.

credit.title: Cime de la Bonette dans le parc du Mercantour
credit.author: JCosson

1968.alt: Black-and-white photo: Jan Janssen in sunglasses holds a bouquet while well-wishers reach to shake his hand
1968.caption: Jan Janssen after winning the 1968 Tour on its final day.

credit.title: Jan Janssen winnaar van de Tour de France 1968
credit.author: Anefo

merckx.alt: Black-and-white photo: riders sprint over a finish line painted on the road, past crowds packed behind barriers under the trees
merckx.caption: The stage 2 finish in Maastricht, 30 June 1969, Merckx's first Tour. Julien Stevens wins.

credit.title: Finish van de 2e etappe in Maastricht 1e Julien Stevens, 2e Wil in het Veld
credit.author: Anefo

merckxb.alt: Black-and-white photo: Eddy Merckx sits on the bonnet of a car with both arms raised, flowers beside him, as his Faema teammates ride in behind
merckxb.caption: Merckx's first win, Vincennes, Paris, 1969.

merckxc.alt: Black-and-white photo: Eddy Merckx rides at the front of a line of riders past a sign for the town of Bergheim
merckxc.caption: Merckx at the front on stage 2, Mulhouse to Strasbourg, 1971.

pace.alt: The peloton rides along a country road past a cornfield, a rider in the yellow jersey among teammates in white near the front
pace.caption: The peloton on the Simacourbe climb, stage 13, 2024.

credit.title: Peloton during Simacourbe climb of Tour de France 2024 stage 13
credit.author: Hugo LUC

paceb.alt: A long single-file peloton stretches down a straight road under an avenue of plane trees
paceb.caption: Strung out in the Combe de Savoie, stage 5, 2024.

credit.title: 5e étape Tour de France 2024 - Peloton en Combe de Savoie
credit.author: Florian Pépellin

pacec.alt: Tadej Pogačar in the yellow jersey, on a yellow bike, rides over cobbles past fans in polka-dot shirts
pacec.caption: Tadej Pogačar on the final stage, 2026, the fastest Tour on record.

credit.title: Tadej Pogačar at 2026 Tour de France (Stage 21) (cropped)
credit.author: Kiril Simeonovski

era.alt: Silent black-and-white newsreel: the peloton races through crowds in Dutch towns, along a harbour, past a lighthouse and round a seafront road
era.caption: The 1954 Tour starts in Amsterdam, the first start outside France. Silent 45-second extract.

credit.title: De Tour de France 1954 (extract, sound removed)
credit.author: Polygoon-Profilti / Beeld en Geluid

field2019.alt: A packed peloton in bright team kit sweeps through a cobbled street in Reims, spectators along the barriers
field2019.caption: The peloton in Reims, 2019.

bernal2019.alt: Egan Bernal in the yellow jersey, on a yellow bike, rides through Paris on the final stage
bernal2019.caption: Egan Bernal, the 2019 winner, on the final stage in Paris.

credit.title: Egan Bernal Arrivée 21e étape Tour France 2019 Paris 1
credit.author: Chabe01
